rust_summary: whether an entity may grief blocks (`native_entity_mob_griefing`).
doc_summary: the server checks whether an entity may grief blocks: `native_entity_mob_griefing(entity, mob_griefing, can_grief)` exposes the gamerule and lets mods replace the decision. Currently wired for the Ender Dragon's wall checks and mob-owned small fireballs only. Bundles need "hooks": @API:entity_mob_griefing@.
